patch.summary: 8x8 cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: 8x8 pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 30-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: 8x8 cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price 8x8 against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 30-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
